note: Chronic oral minimal risk level, 1 mg/kg/day as printed, stored as 1000 µg/kg bw per day. Endpoint Neurol.; total uncertainty and modifying factors 90; status Final, cover date 09/08. ATSDR defines an MRL as "an estimate of the daily human exposure to a hazardous substance that is likely to be without appreciable risk of adverse noncancer health effects over a specified duration" — chronic meaning "1 year or longer", which is why only the chronic row is used. Stored as TDI: it is a tolerable daily intake in everything but name, and the resolver treats TDI as a contaminant ceiling resolved by strictest.
